growth.feedback.outcome-native-verify: The TEST leaf adapter requires native Grounded Growth outcome or portfolio verification before mapping feedback.
growth.feedback.need-map: Verified outcome needs map to deterministic evidence and open candidate needs; candidates remain attention only.
growth.feedback.blocked-order: Evidence, regression, refresh and capability-cycle holds deterministically replace downstream beneficiary tests with the first repair or refresh need.
growth.feedback.route-state-bind: Exact route references are digest-bound caller declarations; the adapter does not fetch or authenticate them and cannot let them override verified outcomes.
growth.feedback.gei-compatible: Generated evidence records and improvement needs pass the native Grounded Evolution Intelligence v0.1.0 schemas.
growth.feedback.deduplicate: Exact active need identity or explicit digest-bound coverage can suppress duplicates; resolved conflicts reopen visibly.
growth.feedback.authority.none: The leaf owns no state, emits no evolution direction, writes no registry, and grants no execution, install, promotion, merge, CANON, Foundation or model-training authority.

growth.feedback.current-review: A technical steward reviewed the current candidate as WAIT_FOR_EVIDENCE attention only; no direction, registry write, execution, merge or human acceptance is claimed.
